notes.content:
Minor Bug fixes including: 

	Fixed a bug where a player crew member could die on loading a save if they were ragdolled while the game was saved.

notes.title: Game Patch #1
notes.content:
Thanks so much for the support during the launch of The Galactic Junkers!

Today we are pleased to share a new patch based on your feedback, comments, and bug reports.

We want to make sure the game is the best it can possibly be and continue to work through the list of feedback! Keep your thoughts coming to us on the [b]Steam Community Hub[/b] and our official [url=https://www.twitter.com/GalacticJunkers][b]Twitter[/b][/url].

Here are some of the main fixes that we have included in this update!

[u][h2]Gameplay Fixes & Improvements[/h2][/u]

[list]
[*] Reduced automatic system degradation rate, and system degradation is no longer faster with more users.
[*] Reduced the health of cookie cutters.
[*] Removed some speech bubbles from player crew.
[*] Characters stop moving when given an overwatch command.
[*] Orders can be given to crew whilst they're ragdolled or in the middle of exiting a console.
[*] Screen edge camera rotation is turned off by default.
[*] A single laz gun comes free with every purchase of a new ship turret.
[*] Ship steering input resets while in the interior view.
[*] Player’s crew being shot doesn't cancel a move order.
[*] Updated crew card selection highlights to be more clear.
[*] Made subsector circles more visible on the map.
[*] Speech bubbles do not block input.
[*] Adjusted the default camera position on the Goliath-class ship.
[*] Improved mining behavior when using an aft-mounted mining laz.
[/list]

[u][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][/u]

[list]
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur on moving characters between ships.
[*] Fixed a memory leak that could degrade performance.
[*] Fixed some bugs where crew would receive unexpected target positions upon orders.
[*] Fixed bugs where characters could end up in strange places during some missions.
[*] Fixed strange behavior on a couple of shipwreck models.
[*] Stopped characters dipping through the floor while recovering from a ragdoll state.
[*] Prevented civilians trying to hitch a ride on the player's ship.
[*] Fixed a bug where tutorial instructions could block other missions.
[*] Fixed two-handed weapons trying to enter the wrong inventory slots, or not storing correctly in a locker.
[*] Made sure purchased robots transfer to newy-purchased ships properly.
[*] Ensured all weapons on an owned Orca-class ship can be viewed on the ship screen.
[*] Prevented the medipod on the Orca-class ship from remaining permanently unpowered.
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause inventory icons not to display properly.
[*] Gun models load on a newly purchased ship if the player bought extra weapons before buying a weapon system.
[*] Fixed a bug where unmanned weapons could fire after loading a save.
[*] Prevented a way of making items disappear in character item exchange UI.
[*] Locked the camera from moving while a text input field is selected.
[*] Fixed a bug preventing the wardrobe screen from scrolling after repeated openings.
[*] Sleeping characters wake up when booted out of bed on transfer to a new ship.
[*] Stopped the wrong character from taking a spacesuit or helmet off when swapping items in a locker.
[/list]

notes.title: The Galactic Junkers: OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Ahoy, Galactic Space Captains!

The Galactic Junkers is OUT NOW on Steam & Xbox [i](more consoles soon)[/i]! Get a limited time [b]10% DISCOUNT[/b] right here on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1243160/The_Galactic_Junkers/

Get ready to explore strange new worlds, meet weird new people, try dodgy food, and boldly fumble where no space captain has fumbled before. Take a look at our NEW launch trailer!

[previewyoutube=_IFH-J96ofc;full]https://youtu.be/_IFH-J96ofc[/previewyoutube]
Budding space captains can jump behind the helm of their very own spaceship and scour the galaxy on the lookout for derelict ships to board.  But beware of pesky bounty hunters who are hot on your tail and don't forget to keep an eye out for those troublesome aliens that lurk in the vacuum of space.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305503/a4490c38810e8682d504a57c5f1147c231fe4ec8.png[/img]
Assemble your crew, and storm ahead on an adventure of a lifetime. You won't be diving in alone, you'll have your ship's built in AI system (known as M.O.E) to help guide you along the way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305503/4ee064ad5be7664486026932e53ae7c6ebf66e56.png[/img]
The destruction of the Earth would be known as the Great Cataclysm. By some miracle it didn’t take the whole solar system with it, but it did force humanity to spread further into the reaches of space, living on space stations and whatever ships they could find. No one knew what caused it but everyone was too busy foraging for scrap metal and any cool memorabilia to really care any more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305503/fb3abda24aee62835cffe5270c12a503b6cd1572.png[/img]
Now fighting each other, either as members of the Galactic Union, or the many pirate factions, humanity is trying to make a living in this dangerous place, so it is important that any adventurer knows their opponent and where to find them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305503/048783ff4dd1ea1200aa362b8ac714eedb6a3a68.png[/img]
Finally, we wanted to send a massive thank you for your continued support.

Thank you for allowing us to make our dreams a reality. We feel incredibly lucky to have the support from such a great community and being able to work with each other.

- Mark & James

notes.title: Closed Beta Test Announcement
notes.content:
Calling all space captains!

Today we are giving YOU the chance to get a hands on with The Galactic Junkers for the first time ever. Be vigilant though, as invites are limited!

[previewyoutube=H2byrpsKvCs;full][/previewyoutube]

We know. Being the captain of a spaceship can be a bit daunting, especially when there’s a price on your head. Not to mention the bounty hunters, space pirates, and even the Galactic Union are trying to hunt you down.

Fear not, because all you need are your wits, your crew, and your trusty ship! Sure, the ship might be falling apart and your crew isn’t… well… competent to say the least. But! With a little luck and support from M.O.E (your ship’s trusty built in AI) we just know you’ll be able to keep everything ship-shape.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305503/81809db53183349d9f2daf129b06c39331223b6b.png[/img]

[h2][b][url=https://forms.gle/R7AgQW7uV1vXVeem6]REGISTER FOR CLOSED BETA ACCESS[/url][/b][/h2]

Think you’ve got what it takes to take on the madness that is about to unfold? Closed Beta will be starting on 31st May for 1 week!

Register your interest to join the closed beta test by [url=https://forms.gle/R7AgQW7uV1vXVeem6]CLICKING HERE[/url].

Keep in touch with us on [url=www.twitter.com/GalacticJunkers]Twitter[/url] and our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1243160]Steam Community Hub[/url] for the latest news and info!

See you out there in space... perhaps...

James & Mark

notes.title: Developer Update!
notes.content:
Mark and James here!

Today we have some really exciting news to share about the future of The Galactic Junkers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305503/9a1064d405e5349936a1bf12bbca36f1bf4d6713.png[/img]
As you know, we were looking to Kickstarter for backing to help us get over the final hurdle of bringing our dream game to PC and consoles. However, the fantastic Green Man Gaming Publishing stepped in at the perfect time. 💚

Green Man Gaming’s Publishing team got it from the off, and that was something that was important to us, there’s a lot of off-kilter humour in The Galactic Junkers that we were pleased someone else was appreciating it outside of our little circle!

Now we focus heavily on developing the game and making it the best it can possibly be whilst involving the community and players along the way. 👩‍🚀👨‍🚀👩‍🚀👨‍🚀

This is really exciting for us as two indie developers, and we are so excited to be collaborating with Green Man Gaming Publishing on this adventure!

Although all this exciting stuff has been happening, the work hasn’t slowed down on developing the game. Here’s a quick update on what else we have been working on so far.

[b][h2]🪐 DEVELOPER UPDATE 🪐[/h2][/b]
🚀 New Character Added
🚀 First Half of Tutorial Added
🚀 Started Work on Expeditions
🚀 Console Development Started
🚀 New Level + Sectors Started is this the same as Expedition? Matthew Plumb
🚀 Localisation & Translation Fixes
🚀 Controller Support Added
🚀 Bug Fixes & Optimisations

Stay tuned for more updates, sneak peeks, and more. We are really excited to be going on this adventure with Green Man Gaming Publishing!

[b][h2]🪐 STAY IN TOUCH 🪐[/h2][/b]

notes.title: Fully Backed on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

First and foremost, a huge thank you for the heartwarming outpour of love towards us. The response has been amazing from the second we shared The Galactic Junkers with the world. 

We have been working on developing the game and getting it to a polished state and can't wait to get the first iteration the game into your hands!

Today we have some VERY exciting news to share...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305503/4e5f90e690daa53a97c6e261637433ca8648fd5b.png[/img]

The Galactic Junkers has been approached and privately backed. This means we can now bring our dream to reality without needing to ask for that final bit of support from the community!

We are both really excited by this opportunity and know this private backing is what will be best for the game. Rest assured, involving the community in the direction and during the development of the game is still going to be at the heart of everything we do.

We'll have more to share about this exciting news very soon, but for now, please consider supporting us by helping spread the word! You can follow us on Twitter or add the game to your wishlist. We'll be posting regular updates about the progress of the game right here!

We'll be keeping you updated every step of the way.

[h2][b]WISHLIST THE GALACTIC JUNKERS ON STEAM[/b][/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1243160/The_Galactic_Junkers/

[h2][b]FOLLOW US ON TWITTER[/b][/h2]
Keep up with our musings, and the development of the game over on Twitter! You can follow us at: [url=https://twitter.com/GalacticJunkers]https://twitter.com/GalacticJunkers[/url]

We hope you're as excited as we are! Stay tuned for more news and information very soon!

- Mark & James

notes.title: Welcome to The Galactic Junkers
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We have been keeping our heads down and working hard on the development of The Galactic Junkers recently. Today we are ready to show our progress with the world, and invite you on this journey, by bringing our upcoming comedic space combat adventure game to Kickstarter!

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thegalacticjunkers/the-galactic-junkers

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305503/9595209a42a79372d09d0936cc88ecbb89b1c2ec.png[/img]

First, a quick message from M.O.E! We've installed this trusty AI on every ship to help you aspiring captains on your journey with hints, tips and tricks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305503/edd1fd03537a82cd4ddc485c587b626b3fab752d.png[/img]

[i]"Hello world!

I'll be on hand to guide you through every step of the way on your journey as our newly appointed captain. I'll also be on hand to give you important information and updates from The Evil Twin devs.

Maintaining a ship and crew doesn’t always come easy, especially with all the hull breaches and fires, we are looking for additional funding for the final stage of the Galactic Junkers voyage! If you can assist no matter how great or small you will be rewarded with our gratitude, the chance to take on voyages as part of the Galactic Junkers Crew or even greater rewards!
 
Stay tuned for further communications and more info on what you can expect!"[/i]
                 - M.O.E Your friendly ship AI 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305503/c12cfeaa5ba5c120dada142c13828f81ffd5d6c6.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305503/c12cfeaa5ba5c120dada142c13828f81ffd5d6c6.gif[/img][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305503/2aa4b3cee1992b4e28df75d88e8a66717edc307f.png[/img]

We are Mark & James, two brothers from the not-so sunny United Kingdom. We’ve made Naval Combat games in the past, but The Galactic Junkers is one that is very close to our hearts. When we were young we’d play with our Star Wars figures, watch Blake’s 7 and Doctor Who on TV, and read Marvel, DC and 2000AD comics relentlessly, all this has formed into this crazy 80's inspired sci fi mash up!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305503/1a5821ba2b66c59491ad0463c7ea9497815e6a5a.png[/img]

The Galactic Junkers will transport you to a far away galaxy to become the space captain you always wanted to be. The only problem is that your ship needs work, there’s a price on your head, and your crew are idiots! What could possibly go wrong...

The Kickstarter campaign marks an important step in the journey for us, because bringing The Galactic Junkers into the hands of the community is so important to us. Not only will the funding from this campaign will go towards the additional development tools and resources needed to bring the project to completion on PC and the addition of console support, it will also let us work closer with the supporters to steer the direction of the game during these crucial development stages!

We know Kickstarter isn't everyone's cup of tea, so you can also support us by telling your friends and Wishlisting the game on Steam!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305503/7c6263590a3f84f1b7fca3537aaaaf05d8f69b93.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1243160/The_Galactic_Junkers/
